intro:
Seven sins. Seven boys. None of them willing to make it easy.
Are you ready to earn their trust?
description:
A fantasy realm ruled by emotion and excess, where seven boys each carry the weight of a sin. 
Lust. Pride. Wrath. Envy. Gluttony. Sloth. Greed. 

They are extremes of what desire and obsession can look like, beautiful, intense, and entirely consumed by what they are.

Through dialogue and choices, you step into their world and try to reach them. 

One is provocative and always in control. One is cold, elegant, and almost impossible to impress. One burns with anger and keeps everyone at arm's length. Another watches your every move with quiet, desperate jealousy.

Each one is a different challenge. Each one is a different kind of fantasy.

Seven territories divide their world, shaped by the sin that rules them. Lavish palaces, pleasure-soaked gardens, dim and restless corridors where nothing is what it seems. The deeper you go, the harder it is to leave.


Features:

● SEVEN UNFORGETTABLE CHARACTERS: Seven boys, seven sins, seven completely different ways to get under your skin. None of them easy. All of them worth it.

● DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: Every response shifts the dynamic. Say the wrong thing and you lose ground. Get it right and something real starts to open up.

● CHARACTER AFFINITY SYSTEM: Progressive dates and intimate scenes unlock as your bond grows. The harder the conquest, the more meaningful the connection.

● EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Beautiful illustrations unlock as relationships deepen. Each boy has his own story hidden inside.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your choices lead somewhere unique with each character. Not every path ends in love, but all of them are worth playing.

● 30 DAYS TO CONQUER THEM: The clock is running. Every day you waste is a route that closes, a sin that wins. You do not have forever.


Seven sins. Seven chances at something unexpected.
Which one will you get through to?
